description: SOC-thermal voltage model for high-temperature NaS cell. Cell is ONLY functional in 300-350 degC window. Thermal model maintains operating temperature.

cell.name: Generic high-temperature NaS cell (NGK PS-class T~320 C)
cell.source: Wen, Z. et al. (2008), Mater. Sci. Eng. B 154-155, 73; NGK Insulators NAS battery technical brochure

capacity_ref.note: Nominal capacity at T_op_ref (593.15 K = 320 degC)

R_ref.note: Approximate DC resistance per cell at T_op_ref (320 C, 50% SOC)

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) = a0 + a1*SOC + a2*SOC^2 + a3*SOC^3 + a4*SOC^4 + a5*SOC^5
ocv_coefficients.source: Polynomial fit to representative NaS discharge curve (two-plateau, 1.78-2.08 V)

T_op_min.note: Minimum operating temperature (300 degC); below this Na and S solidify

T_op_max.note: Maximum operating temperature (350 degC); above this risk of thermal runaway

E_a.note: Activation energy for beta-alumina ionic conductivity within the 300-350C window; conductivity varies ~10% over this range
E_a.source: Sudworth & Tilley (1985), The Sodium Sulfur Battery; Wen et al. (2008)

alpha_c.note: Small capacity temperature coefficient within 300-350C operating window
alpha_c.source: NGK NAS brochure; Wen et al. (2008)

dOCV_dT.note: Entropic coefficient for NaS within operating window; small due to molten electrode
dOCV_dT.source: Sudworth & Tilley (1985), The Sodium Sulfur Battery, ch. 3

temperature.note: 300 to 350 degC; OUTSIDE THIS RANGE CELL IS NON-FUNCTIONAL
